question: Which divine figures preside at the Agastya site and at the Urvaśī site?
premises: Āgastye names the first sacred site.
Yajñagarbhas is the presiding figure there.
Urvaśyāṃ names the second sacred site.
Madhusūdanaḥ is the presiding figure there.
inference: Yajñagarbha presides at the Agastya site and Madhusūdana presides at the Urvaśī site.
plain_english: At the Agastya site is Yajñagarbha, and at the Urvaśī site is Madhusūdana.
